issue_request: FHIR-15097 is a Published/Persuasive Orders and Observations FHIR-core Supply change request. It asked that business identifier elements change from 0..1 to 0..*, and the final resolution explicitly limits this tracker to SupplyDelivery.
initial_application: The requested change appears to have been applied in legacy source commit 644f2985adbed8f2ededc714a68a832de4689805, which changed SupplyDelivery.identifier in source/supplydelivery/supplydelivery-spreadsheet.xml from 0..1 to 0..* and updated its definition/comment.
additional_context: The current source is the post-spreadsheet StructureDefinition representation. SupplyDelivery remains in the FHIR core source under source/supplydelivery with an active Supply resource package entry in source/fhir.ini. Later SupplyDelivery work, including FHIR-38818 and FHIR-43379, did not reverse the identifier cardinality. The broad identifier-cardinality request was split across work-group-specific sibling issues; several are already represented on the combined branch and several were no-change/already-handled decisions.
reconciliation: No source file was changed. source/supplydelivery/structuredefinition-SupplyDelivery.xml already defines SupplyDelivery.identifier with min 0, max *, and type Identifier, matching FHIR-15097.
